48116bdaea783754.description: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. The Role We're building local Enterprise Sales Pods across global markets — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in Riyadh. This is not a remote overlay on an existing territory. You will own a named-account list of 30–40 enterprise accounts in Saudi Arabia, and your job is to turn those accounts into production Telnyx customers. You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated FDE — not a demo resource, but a technical partner who designs architectures, builds POCs, and gets the first workload live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall. This is a founding role. You'll help define how Telnyx sells into enterprise accounts in Saudi Arabia, set the playbook, and build the references that the next wave of hires will follow. The Pod Model Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload. We sell the workload , not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu. What You'll Do Own a territory of 30–40 named enterprise accounts in Saudi Arabia, narrowing to ~10 Tier 1 accounts worth $1M+ in annual potential Build executive relationships — get in the room with CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering, and line-of-business owners Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, design the commercial architecture with your FDE, negotiate, and close Sell production outcomes, not individual products — lead with "let's deploy an AI agent that operates your SOC or NOC workflow," not "which Telnyx products do you want?" Agree the commercial destination before any custom work begins — no free discovery or free development Maintain disciplined POC management: every POC has a named executive sponsor, written success criteria, production pricing discussed, a decision date, and a signed commercial document. POCs end in production or they end Expand the account — one workload becomes three, one $500K customer becomes a $2M customer Build local references and case studies in your market Provide accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting — no surprises What We're Looking For 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling into the Saudi Arabian or broader GCC market — CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecom, AI/ML, or similarly technical infrastructure Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota ($1M+ deals) Experience selling to both executive and technical buyers — you can hold your own in the boardroom and in the architecture review Hunter mentality — you build your own pipeline and thrive on outbound, in-person selling Strong consultative selling skills: can build a clear, compelling ROI story for both technical and business buyers Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, etc.) Comfortable with modern sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, etc.) Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Arabic. You listen before you pitch. Willingness to be in the field — visiting customers in person is a core part of this role Based in Riyadh, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across the Kingdom and broader GCC Bonus Points For Fortune 500 or large enterprise new business sales experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC Complex sales cycles including RFPs, POCs, and competitive bake-offs C-Level selling experience — you can navigate procurement, security, and legal complexity, including Saudi government and semi-government entities (PIF portfolio companies, giga-projects like NEOM, Red Sea Global, Diriyah) Understanding of SIP trunking, phone number provisioning, carrier networks, or AI/ML platforms Established relationships in the Riyadh enterprise ecosystem — banking, telecom (STC, Mobily, Zain), healthcare, or government sectors Local language skills beyond English and Arabic

48ac43d7c1f4d662.description: The Director, Parking is the asset owner and accountable business lead for all municipal parking assets across Qiddiya. The role establishes the commercial and operating model, governance and performance framework to secure sustainable commercial returns while ensuring parking assets are safe, well maintained, customer-focused and operationally ready for business-as-usual and major-event demand. The position leads parking operator procurement and oversight, revenue and yield optimisation, lifecycle planning, asset assurance and stakeholder integration. It requires a strategic and commercially astute parking leader with substantial operating experience in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the ability to build and lead a high-performing team. Key Responsabilities Asset Ownership and Strategy • Act as the accountable asset owner for Qiddiya municipal parking, including applicable on-street, off-street, structured, surface, remote, park-and-ride and shared parking assets. • Develop and implement the city-wide parking strategy, operating model, governance framework, service standards and investment priorities aligned with Qiddiya’s growth and visitor proposition. • Assess and recommend the optimal delivery model for the parking portfolio, including in-house operations, commercial partnerships with proven operators and future design, develop, build and operate arrangements. • Maintain clear ownership, operating and commercial boundaries between City Asset Management, Transportation Operations, O&M, districts, venues, developers and contracted parking operators. • Provide strategic advice and concise executive reporting on portfolio performance, risks, commercial opportunities, investment requirements and key decisions. Commercial Performance and Revenue Optimisation • Own the parking business plan, revenue strategy, pricing principles, demand assumptions, budgets, forecasts and approved commercial targets. • Optimise sustainable returns through appropriate tariff structures, yield management, permits, subscriptions, validations, event pricing, partnerships and ancillary revenue opportunities. • Evaluate and recommend management, concession, revenue-share and hybrid operating models, protecting revenue integrity and whole-life asset value. • Monitor income, operating costs, leakage, utilisation, margin and return on investment, and lead corrective action where performance is below plan. • Work with Finance & Controls, Legal and Procurement to establish transparent commercial controls, audit requirements, contractual protections and reporting. Operator Procurement and Performance • Lead the definition of operator requirements, procurement scopes, evaluation criteria, mobilisation plans and performance specifications for parking operations and associated services. • Manage senior relationships with parking operators and commercial partners, ensuring clear accountability for safety, service, revenue, compliance and continuous improvement. • Set and govern contractual KPIs, service levels, incentives, deductions, audit rights and escalation arrangements. • Ensure operators maintain capable leadership, trained resources, robust operating procedures and effective Saudi workforce development plans. Asset Lifecycle, Maintenance and Assurance • Set asset standards and lifecycle plans covering condition, availability, maintenance, cleanliness, lighting, signage, equipment, systems, accessibility and customer facilities. • Assure operability, maintainability and commercial functionality through design reviews, stage gates, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance. • Coordinate with O&M and specialist service functions to ensure maintenance delivery meets approved standards, while retaining asset-owner oversight rather than day-to-day contractor management. • Prioritise renewals and capital investment using asset condition, operational risk, customer impact, revenue potential and whole-life cost. BAU and Event Operations Readiness • Ensure the parking portfolio supports reliable daily operations and can scale safely and efficiently for major events, peak periods and special activations. • Coordinate event parking requirements with Transportation Operations, Public Realm Major Events, Security, FLS, Medical, Logistics, ICT, districts, venues and event organisers. • Require operators to maintain approved event operating plans, staffing and traffic-interface arrangements, incident procedures, business continuity and service-recovery plans. • Use post-event reviews and performance data to improve capacity planning, commercial outcomes, customer experience and future readiness. Customer Experience, Technology and Compliance • Establish consistent customer standards for access, wayfinding, payment, assistance, complaints, accessibility and service recovery across the portfolio. • Define business requirements for parking technology, revenue-control systems, data, dashboards and system integration in coordination with QTech and relevant City Operations functions. • Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi legislation, municipal requirements, permits, safety standards, contractual obligations and Qiddiya governance. • Use reliable operational and commercial data to support forecasting, pricing, asset planning, performance management and executive decisions. Leadership and Capability Building • Build and lead a high-performing parking asset management team with clear accountabilities, objectives and succession plans. • Develop Saudi parking capability through recruitment, mentoring, structured knowledge transfer, professional development and progressive leadership opportunities. • Promote a culture of commercial discipline, customer focus, safety, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. · Bachelor's degree in business, finance, property, asset management, transport, engineering, operations management or a related discipline. · Relevant postgraduate qualification or professional certification in parking, asset management, property, commercial management or operations is advantageous. · Substantial senior leadership experience in the parking industry, including direct experience operating and commercially managing significant parking portfolios. · Detailed knowledge of the parking market, regulatory environment, customer expectations and operator landscape in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. · Demonstrated accountability for parking revenue, pricing, yield, budgets, commercial models, revenue control and portfolio profitability. · Proven experience procuring, mobilising and managing parking operators or service partners through robust contracts and performance frameworks. · Strong experience in asset lifecycle planning, maintenance assurance, operational readiness and handover of new or upgraded parking facilities. · Experience supporting large events, high-volume destinations, mixed-use developments, municipal environments, airports or major visitor attractions is strongly preferred. · Proven people leadership, executive reporting and stakeholder management across government, developers, operators and corporate functions.

48caa8fbb74d8ca8.job_title: Consultant Manager Cyber Operate Cybersecurity Risk Specialist
48caa8fbb74d8ca8.description: About Deloitte Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms globally, recognized for its impact on clients, people, and society. The firm has received multiple awards, including Best Employer in the Middle East and Best Consulting Firm. Deloitte focuses on delivering innovative insights, solving complex challenges, and fostering sustainable growth while upholding integrity and supporting communities. The Role: Consultant Manager, Cyber Operate Third Party Risk Assessor Deloitte is seeking a Consultant Manager, Cyber Operate Third Party Risk Assessor, for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves developing and demonstrating capabilities in third-party and supply chain cybersecurity risk management. Key Responsibilities Design and maintain the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework, including scope, roles, RACI, risk tiering, assessment depth, and risk rating methodology. Develop and maintain third-party cybersecurity policies, processes, procedures, and SOPs for each lifecycle stage (intake, tiering, due diligence, contracting, onboarding, monitoring, reassessment, issue management, exceptions, offboarding). Build supporting toolkits such as tiered questionnaires, evidence checklists, assessment templates, and standard contract clauses. Integrate TPRM steps into procurement and contract management processes to ensure cybersecurity assessments for high-risk suppliers. Define and monitor TPRM KPIs and KRIs, regularly updating the framework based on new NCA requirements, incidents, and lessons learned. Manage the third-party risk lifecycle, including tiering third parties by inherent risk, conducting due diligence, periodic reassessments, and secure offboarding. Assess third parties by reviewing security questionnaires, evidence (*, ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 reports, penetration tests), and conducting remote or on-site assessments for high-risk suppliers. Assess cloud and SaaS providers against NCA CCC and cloud security best practices, and evaluate contractors with access to IT and OT systems. Manage supply chain cybersecurity risk by mapping critical supply chains, setting requirements for secure software and hardware development, and ensuring critical suppliers have tested incident response plans. Define standard cybersecurity and data protection clauses with Procurement and Legal, reviewing contracts to ensure risk findings are reflected in conditions. Track and monitor supplier remediation actions, continuously monitor critical suppliers for breaches, and maintain the third-party inventory and risk register. Report third-party and supply chain risk posture to management and integrate results into the enterprise cyber risk register. Leadership Capabilities Understand Deloitte's purpose and values, exploring opportunities for impact. Demonstrate commitment to personal learning and development, acting as a brand ambassador. Understand expectations and maintain personal accountability for performance. Develop effective communication and relationship-building skills. Understand how daily work contributes to team and business priorities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a professional services environment. The role involves collaboration across various internal teams and external third parties. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

48efbc46854d707d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الشريك التقني لتقنية المعلومات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الدلم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات البيع والتحصيل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات، وإعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء. كما يتولى مسؤولية التواصل مع العملاء لتقديم عروض البيع، إتمام الصفقات، ومتابعة تحصيل الديون، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء من خلال الزيارات أو الاتصالات لترويج المنتجات والخدمات، وتقديم عروض البيع مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليلها. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، الدلم. سيعمل الموظف ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المؤسسة وتوسيع قاعدة عملائها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.
